title: Artemisinin-based combination therapy in uncomplicated falciparum malaria: NO POOLABLE DATA
topic_state: NOT BUILT -- coherent topic, no registration posts results
which_limb_fails: NONE -- the limbs pass; the DATA are absent
verification_basis: All five registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: conditions, arm groups with types, registered primaries, and results-section presence.

handbook_authority.handbook: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions
handbook_authority.c62: 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.poolable_reason: FIVE TRIALS, ONE DISEASE, AND NOT ONE OF THEM POSTS RESULTS. This is NOT a limb failure and the distinction matters. The topic is COHERENT: all five registrations describe uncomplicated Plasmodium falciparum malaria under five different registry strings, and all register an adequate-clinical-and-parasitological-response primary. The participants, intervention and outcome limbs PASS. THE TOPIC CANNOT BE BUILT BECAUSE THE DATA ARE NOT THERE: NCT01704508, NCT04565184, NCT04767191, NCT05192265 and NCT06076213 were each read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18 and NONE has a posted results section. A pool would require importing numbers from publications, which this corpus does not do without stating mixed provenance, and no publication has been read. AUTHORITY: Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.3 -- 'A systematic review need not contain any meta-analyses.'

primary.why_this_verdict_differs_from_the_eleven: The eleven topics closed on 2026-08-18 fail a LIMB -- their trials answer different questions and pooling them would be incoherent however good the data. THIS TOPIC WOULD POOL IF THE DATA EXISTED. It is recorded as NOT BUILT rather than NOT POOLABLE, and it is the one topic on this list that a later results posting could revive.
primary.what_would_make_this_buildable: Any of the five posting a results section, or a decision to read published reports and declare mixed provenance per trial as INCRETIN_HFpEF does. THE SECOND ROUTE IS AVAILABLE NOW AND HAS NOT BEEN TAKEN.
primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that these trials are poor or unreported -- several are recent and may be ongoing. NOT that no published synthesis of artemisinin combination therapy exists; many do, and none has been read here. NOT that the drugs differ or do not differ in efficacy. ONLY that this page cannot build a pool from what its registrations currently post.
